name: Voxel-Cell Duality Mapping
definition: A mapping technique that logically shifts scalar values backward by half a voxel width to treat them as corners of cells, allowing the ray tracer to intersect 8-voxel cell primitives defined by the stored leaf values.
summary: Voxel-Cell Duality Mapping enables efficient ray tracing of isosurfaces in octrees by logically shifting scalar positions to define cell corners, retrieving neighbors at intersection time to avoid eightfold storage expansion.
